title: Policy and World Modeling Co-Training for Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.02388v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model (LLM) agents by teaching them which actions lead to high rewards, but provides little supervision on what those actions do to the environment. World modeling (WM) can fill this gap, yet existing approaches often require separate simulators, extra training stages, or additional inference-time computation. We observe that on-policy RL rollouts already contain the needed signal: each transition pairs an action with its resulting next observation. Based on this observation, we propose PaW, a Policy and World modeling co-training framework that adds auxiliary WM supervision to the same policy during RL, without changing the inference paradigm. To make auxiliary WM supervision informative and stable, PaW introduces three components: action-entropy-based WM data selection, noise-tolerant WM loss, and reward-adaptive loss balancing. translated_title: 面向语言智能体的策略与世界模型协同训练
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）通过教导大型语言模型（LLM）智能体哪些动作能带来高回报来提升其能力，但对其动作对环境产生的影响几乎没有提供监督信号。世界模型（WM）可以填补这一空白，然而现有方法通常需要单独的模拟器、额外的训练阶段或额外的推理时计算。我们观察到，同策略的强化学习采样轨迹中已经包含了所需的信号：每次状态转移都将一个动作与其产生的下一观测配对。基于这一观察，我们提出了PaW，一个策略与世界模型协同训练框架，它在强化学习过程中为同一策略添加辅助的世界模型监督，而无需改变推理范式。为了使辅助世界模型监督既信息丰富又稳定，PaW引入了三个组件：基于动作熵的世界模型数据选择、容忍噪声的世界模型损失以及回报自适应的损失平衡。在三个智能体任务基准上的实验表明（原文摘要截断）……
tldr: 提出了PaW协同训练框架，利用强化学习采样轨迹中动作与下一观测天然配对的信号，在训练同一策略时加入辅助世界模型监督，并通过基于动作熵的数据选择、容忍噪声的损失函数和回报自适应的损失平衡三项技术实现稳定有效的训练，无需额外模拟器或推理开销。
en_tdlr: PaW is a co-training framework that exploits the natural pairing of actions and next observations in on-policy RL rollouts to add auxiliary world modeling supervision to the same policy, stabilized by action-entropy-based data selection, noise-tolerant WM loss, and reward-adaptive loss balancing, without requiring separate simulators or extra inference-time computation.
